messages:
sasha: quick check — finalizing release notes for v2.14.0. Want to lock internal blast copy and pin owners by noon. can we do a dry-run of deploybot cues in staging?
kevin: +1. i pushed a tiny tweak to the microcopy earlier, want it in the internal note. sending snippet in a sec.
sasha: drop it here please. looking for 2 lines max for the slack blurb.
tara: suggestion: 'Platform: lower inference tail latency through smarter batching. Ops: see rollout & rollback lanes below.' keeps it short for the team blast.
ellie: can we call out the exact pinned version? folks need it for Dedicated customer rollouts.
matt: pinned -> model-serving@v2.14.0 (sha: a1b2c3f). will keep that pinned in deploy config.
sasha: ok, add that line. also add a short rollback threshold: if error rate > 0.8% for 5min -> roll back to v2.13.9
kevin: deploy-bot dry-run from staging would be great so ops can validate the cue messages. @deploy-bot can you run a simulated announce for thread 9666601234?
deploy-bot: running dry-run for thread 9666601234 in staging. will emit the same messages as prod but flagged [dry-run]. ETA ~3m.
ops-oncall: heads-up — I'll standby for the dry-run and validate oncall hooks (pager suppressors enabled for dry-run).
deploy-bot: dry-run complete. emitted messages: 
- "[DRY-RUN] Release v2.14.0 scheduled: canary in us-west for 30m, then ramp to 50% for 15m. Pin: model-serving@v2.14.0"
- "Rollback policy: if 5m error rate > 0.8% OR latency p95 increases > 30% -> automatic rollback to v2.13.9"
- "Owners: sasha (release), tara (docs), matt (deploy), ops-oncall (pager)"
sasha: nice. can someone sanity-check the timings? canary 30m -> 50% 15m sounds good?
tara: LGTM. maybe call out a blackout window for EU midnight -> 03:00 UTC to avoid L10n hits.
matt: canary windows updated to respect blackout. config snippet: 
```
canary: {region: "us-west", duration: "30m"}
ramp: {to: "50%", duration: "15m"}
blackout: {region: "eu", start: "00:00Z", end: "03:00Z"}
```
kevin: i'll fold the snippet into the internal note as an appendix. also adding the microcopy: 
"v2.14.0 reduces inference tail latency via smarter batching. No API changes. Monitor token cost metrics for any regressions."
sasha: perfect. last ask — who will post the internal slack blast? we should tag release owners and set pin.
stasha: (typo) meant to say — matt will post?
matt: i can post and pin. i'll schedule the internal blast at T+10 (10 minutes before canary starts) so people have time to read.
ops-oncall: once matt posts, i'll verify oncall routing and confirm the pager thresholds match the rollback policy.
sasha: thanks all. i'll update the release notes doc with the final blurb and the rollback lines. leaving this thread open for any last-minute tweaks. :thumbsup:
kevin: small nit — add a line about Dedicated customer heads-up for pinned rolling. i've DM'd the account rep list.
sasha: added. closing after matt posts the scheduled blast.
matt: posting at 2024-04-18T14:20:00Z (scheduled). pin and standby.
